desc: Prove the upper bound using the sums of the largest and smallest values.
Prove attainability via repeatedly removing adjacent elements with opposite high/low labels.
Show that an unmatched element in an odd-length sequence has an even zero-based index and splits the sequence into independent even-length segments.
Verify prefix/suffix indexing and handle even and odd \(N\) separately.
Validate the implementation against all public samples and edge cases.
